eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 7:05 AM on AUG 28, 2026 Effective until 3:05 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix Police Department is looking for Kaleb Wyble last seen on foot near North 19th Avenue and West Evans Drive, wearing a black tank top shirt with gray shorts and black Nike shoes. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
